label: 1 - Acquisition
info: Modbus TCP / SunSpec poll of the (simulated) inverter, INCLUDING the observed effective §14a power limit. Reads holding registers 0..8 every 2s and normalizes to the telemetry contract.

name: Acquisition (Modbus TCP/SunSpec poll incl. effective grid limit)
info: Reads inverter registers on an interval and normalizes them (docs/contracts/mqtt-telemetry.schema.json).

name: decode SunSpec -> reading

label: 2 - Publish
info: MQTT publish (QoS1) to ems/{tenant}/{site}/{device}/telemetry and .../status. Plain TCP in dev; structured so mTLS can be enabled later (see README). Only outbound connections.

name: Publish (MQTT QoS1 -> EMQX; mTLS-ready)
info: Publishes contract-conformant telemetry/status to EMQX. No inbound ports on the edge.

name: build telemetry (contract)
build status

label: 3 - Schedule-Exec
info: Subscribe to the retained .../schedule topic, cache it, and each 15-min slot write the slot setpoint to the inverter (via Guards).

name: Schedule-Exec (retained schedule, 15-min slots)
info: Caches the retained schedule and applies the current slot setpoint via Guards.

name: cache schedule
select active slot

label: 4 - Default-Watchdog
info: On missing/stale schedule or lost connection, fall back to a simple self-consumption default (PV surplus -> battery, discharge on grid import).

name: Default-Watchdog (self-consumption default on outage)
info: Takes over when the schedule is stale; battery follows PV - load. Guards clamp it.

name: self-consumption default

label: 5 - Guards
info: Local plausibility / limit checks (charge/discharge power, SoC bounds, observed §14a envelope) before any write to the inverter.

name: Guards (local plausibility checks before write)
info: Clamps/blocks setpoints that violate local limits, then writes FC6 to the inverter.

name: guards (clamp + limit checks)
enable setpoint (reg41=1)
